model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and training rewards for various agent training configurations. The x-axis represents training steps, ranging from 100 to 500, with linear scale and tick labels spaced at intervals of 50. The y-axis represents training rewards, ranging from -0.05 to 0.4, with linear scale and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. A blue line depicts the training rewards for the Llama-On-Policy-Easy agent, starting at approximately 0.02 and fluctuating between approximately 0.18 and 0.22 across the x-axis. A red line represents the training rewards for the Llama-On-Policy-Hard agent, starting at approximately -0.01 and fluctuating between approximately 0.03 and 0.07 across the x-axis. A teal line indicates the training rewards for the Llama-Luffy-Easy agent, starting at approximately -0.03 and fluctuating between approximately 0.01 and 0.09 across the x-axis. A purple line indicates the training rewards for the Llama-Luffy-Hard agent, starting at approximately -0.05 and fluctuating between approximately -0.02 and 0.03 across the x-axis.
